arguments.value: This agreement is between Rise (Tianjin) Education Information Consulting Co., Ltd. as the Service Provider and [•] as the Service Recipient. The Service Provider will provide operation support services to the Service Recipient, including academic support, enrollment support, customer support, and, if included, human resources, financial management, legal, internet technology, and administrative support. The services are non-exclusive, so the Service Provider may provide similar services to others as well. The Service Recipient must pay the Service Provider the service fees or commissions and service fees set out in Schedule 1, in the manner and to the bank account specified in the agreement, and the fees are paid quarterly under written payment instructions. The Service Provider owns all rights and intellectual property related to the services, including anything created or derived from providing them. The parties must keep the agreement and related information confidential. If a party defaults, the other party may seek damages; if the Service Recipient pays late, it must pay liquidated damages of 0.5% per day on the unpaid amount, and if payment is more than 15 days late, the Service Provider may terminate the agreement. The agreement ends when its term expires without renewal, if both parties agree to end it, or if the Service Provider terminates after the Service Recipient’s default. Disputes are to be resolved by consultation first and then by arbitration at the Beijing Arbitration Commission. The agreement is governed by the dispute resolution and arbitration clause stated in the source; the source does not separately state a governing law.
